From: Haley Ng <haley@edgelytics.io>

Date: Sun, 21 Jun 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Warm-start soak: additional credits for 48h QPS validation

Hi Markus —

Thanks again for the onboarding help this week. Our engineering team is planning a 48-hour warm-start soak to validate sustained QPS and cold-start tail latency for the model route we plan to put into production. We started on the trial account you provisioned, but we’re approaching the credit cap and still need to run multi-region passes (US east + west) and a couple of cold-restart cycles.

Attached is a short test plan (edgelytics-warmstart-testplan.pdf) that outlines traffic profile, target QPS, and the latency targets we’ll measure. High level ask: can Redwood provision a short-term sandbox top-up (promo voucher or temporary capacity voucher) to cover ~120k additional model tokens / throughput for the 48-hour window starting Tuesday 2026-06-23 00:00 UTC?

This run is gating our internal preflight; if we get the performance numbers we need, we expect a formal procurement conversation and an initial dedicated capacity commit in Q3.

Appreciate a quick confirmation so we can lock in the test schedule.

Best,
Haley Ng
Engineering Lead, Edgelytics
haley@edgelytics.io
